articles.title: Trump discusses Middle East de-escalation with Qatar’s emir, and other Mideast news
articles.description: U.S. President Donald Trump discusses efforts to de-escalate tensions in the Middle East during a call with Qatar's emir. The conversation focused on international efforts to end tensions, with Qatar mediating between the United States and Iran. The Qatari emir emphasizes the importance of dialogue and diplomacy to resolve disputes and ensure regional security. Meanwhile, Iran’s foreign minister spoke with Egypt’s foreign minister on Thursday. The Egyptian minister stressed the need for diplomatic solutions and urges flexibility and compromise. Iran’s foreign minister has also held talks with Turkey and Gulf leaders to discuss security and stability.
